Laptop sold by wholesaler 1 and wholesaler 2 together on Thursday is what per cent of laptop sold by wholesalers 3 on Friday?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Laptop sold by wholesaler 1 and wholesaler 2 together on Thursday = 24 + 14 = 38

Laptop sold by wholesaler 3 on Friday = 19

Required percentage = (38/19) × 100 = 200

**∴ The required answer is 200%.**
